primary.title: Gold Steady as Uncertainty Clouds Talks to End US-Iran War
primary.summary: Gold was steady as renewed clashes in the Middle East cast doubt over negotiations between the US and Iran to end the war that’s upended energy flows and heightened inflation concerns.
